title: ConfigSecretPut
description: common.config-secret-put@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of PUT /internal/config/:namespace/secrets/:key on a service's openvibe-shared/config admin routes. The value is written once, sealed as an envelope under the service's KEK (or kept as today when it has none), and never returned, logged or put in values_json. Its answer is the marker: { redacted: true, fingerprint, hint (four characters), set_at, set_by, bound_to }, as common.config-namespace@1 defines it. A `x-bind` key on the namespace schema binds the secret to another key's value (a provider key to its base_url origin); a changed bind no longer opens the value until the owner enters it again.

reason.description: Why the secret is set; it is the revision's reason in the history.
